api_error.description: FastAPI request handling, routing, validation, or response serialization failure.
api_error.typical_next_step: Inspect trace_id in /api/v1/observability/traces/{trace_id} and endpoint logs.

worker_error.description: Celery task execution, retry, cancellation, or task state persistence failure.
worker_error.typical_next_step: Check workflow task status, worker logs, and task payload summary.

rag_error.description: Retrieval, reranking, evidence assembly, or grounding context failure.
rag_error.typical_next_step: Inspect retrieved evidence ids, source_type coverage, and sufficiency reasoning.

llm_error.description: Cloud or local model call failure, structured output parse failure, or generation timeout.
llm_error.typical_next_step: Inspect model backend, prompt stage, structured parse status, and fallback path.

tool_error.description: Internal tool execution or tool argument validation failure.
tool_error.typical_next_step: Check tool_name, sanitized tool_args, approval status, and idempotency key.

approval_error.description: Durable HITL request, decision, resume, or approval policy failure.
approval_error.typical_next_step: Inspect approval request payload snapshot and decision audit event.

outbox_error.description: External side-effect delivery failure such as email, refund request, or escalation dispatch.
outbox_error.typical_next_step: Check outbox status, delivery attempts, idempotency key, and external service response.

mcp_error.description: MCP tool/resource/prompt execution failure or permission denial.
mcp_error.typical_next_step: Check MCP actor, allowed scopes, write-tool flag, and sanitized tool input.
